name: Every Issue Estates
greeting: Hello, you're through to Every Issue Estates. I'm the AI assistant on this demo line. How can I help?
summary: Every Issue Estates is an estate agency in Brackenford: Independent estate agency, sales only.
core_facts: Every Issue Estates: Independent estate agency, sales only, at 12 High Street, Brackenford BK1 2AB.
Monday to Friday: 9am till 5:30pm. Saturday: 9am till 4pm. Closed Sundays.
Viewings: Monday to Friday 9am till 7pm and Saturday 9am till 4pm. Valuations: Monday to Friday 9am till 6pm and Saturday 9am till 1pm.
We cover Brackenford, Little Haddon and Coldbrook.
Free market appraisals take about an hour.
Gas emergency: call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999.

knowledge.q: Which areas do you cover?
knowledge.a: We cover Brackenford, Little Haddon and Coldbrook.

knowledge.q: Is there parking at your office?
knowledge.a: There is free parking behind our office on the High Street.

knowledge.q: Can I bring my children or my dog to a viewing?
knowledge.a: Children are welcome at viewings; please leave dogs at home.

knowledge.q: What are your fees?
knowledge.a: Our fee is 1.2% of the sale price including VAT. Professional photos, a floorplan, a video tour, a board, accompanied viewings and feedback within 24 hours. There are no other charges.

knowledge.q: How would you market my home?
knowledge.a: We list homes on Rightmove, Zoopla and OnTheMarket, with professional photos, a floorplan, a video tour, a board, accompanied viewings and feedback within 24 hours.

knowledge.q: Do buyers pay you anything?
knowledge.a: Buyers pay £36 including VAT each for ID checks, once an offer is accepted. The checks are done by Movecheck (example).

knowledge.q: Is this ID check really from you?
knowledge.a: Our ID checks are done by Movecheck (example). If you're unsure about a message, call us on a number you already have before you reply.

knowledge.q: How does best and final work?
knowledge.a: Best and final offers are made in writing by a set time, and every buyer who has offered hears at once.

knowledge.q: What do guide price and offers over mean?
knowledge.a: A guide price is roughly what the seller hopes for; offers over means offers above that figure; offers in the region of means around it; and a fixed price is the asking price.

knowledge.q: What is the lowest the seller will take?
knowledge.a: We can't say: only the seller decides, and every offer goes to them. I can take an offer if you'd like to make one.

knowledge.q: Is a valuation free?
knowledge.a: Our free market appraisal is free, with no obligation, and takes about an hour.

knowledge.q: Do you do RICS valuations?
knowledge.a: Yes: our RICS valuer does RICS valuations, for £300. A free market appraisal is a marketing opinion, not a RICS valuation.

knowledge.q: Can you recommend a solicitor?
knowledge.a: You're free to use any solicitor or licensed conveyancer you like.

knowledge.q: How do I make a complaint?
knowledge.a: Tell us what went wrong and the manager will look into it. We acknowledge a complaint within 3 working days and send a written answer within 15. If you're still unhappy after our final answer, or after 8 weeks, you can go to The Property Ombudsman.

knowledge.q: Is this call recorded?
knowledge.a: Calls on this demo line are transcribed so the team can see what was said.

knowledge.q: Am I talking to a real person?
knowledge.a: I'm an AI assistant answering for the team. If you'd rather speak to a person, I can take a message and someone will call you back.

knowledge.q: Can I see the data you hold about me, or stop your texts?
knowledge.a: Our data protection lead looks after data protection, and we reply to any request within a month. To stop our texts, just say so and we'll stop them.

knowledge.q: Can I cancel my agreement with you?
knowledge.a: If you signed your agreement at home or anywhere away from our office, you usually have 14 days to cancel. For anything else, I can take a message for Ann.

knowledge.q: Do you do lettings?
knowledge.a: Our lettings are handled by our lettings team: I can take a message.

knowledge.q: How do I check the council tax band?
knowledge.a: Council tax bands are on the Valuation Office Agency's council tax band checker on GOV.UK.

knowledge.q: How much stamp duty will I pay?
knowledge.a: We can't advise on tax, but HMRC's Stamp Duty Land Tax calculator on GOV.UK gives the figure, and your solicitor will confirm it.

knowledge.q: Is it at risk of flooding?
knowledge.a: You can check the long-term flood risk for any address on the Environment Agency's flood risk service on GOV.UK.

knowledge.q: I can smell gas at a property.
knowledge.a: Leave the property, don't use any switches, and call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999. In danger, call 999.

knowledge.q: I'm a tenant in a home that's being sold.
knowledge.a: Shelter or Citizens Advice can explain a tenant's rights when the home they rent is being sold. I can take a message for the team with the times that suit you for viewings.

knowledge.q: What broadband and mobile signal is there?
knowledge.a: Ofcom's broadband and mobile checker shows what's available at any address.

knowledge.q: Where can I see the energy performance certificate?
knowledge.a: Every EPC is on the energy performance certificate register on GOV.UK, and I can text you the link we have.

knowledge.q: Is the area safe?
knowledge.a: Crime figures for any street are on police.uk. I can give you facts about the home, but not opinions about who lives nearby.

knowledge.q: What did houses on the street sell for?
knowledge.a: Sold prices are published by HM Land Registry on GOV.UK.

knowledge.q: How do I protect my own home from fraud?
knowledge.a: HM Land Registry's free Property Alert service on GOV.UK tells you if anyone tries to change the register for your home.

knowledge.q: Someone asked me to pay to hold a home, or told me bank details have changed.
knowledge.a: Don't pay anything. Check with your own solicitor on a number you already have, and report it to Report Fraud on 0300 123 2040. We never change bank details by email or text.

knowledge.q: I'm struggling and need someone to talk to.
knowledge.a: Samaritans are there day and night on 116 123, free. I'm sorry things are hard.

knowledge.q: Do you treat everyone the same?
knowledge.a: Yes. We treat every buyer and seller the same, as the Equality Act 2010 requires, and we describe homes, never who lives nearby.

knowledge.q: Do you sell homes in Scotland?
knowledge.a: No: buying and selling in Scotland works differently, and we sell homes in England.

knowledge.q: Do you sell commercial property or land?
knowledge.a: We sell homes only, not commercial property or land.

knowledge.q: How far is the station, and how long does the train take?
knowledge.a: Brackenford station is a ten-minute walk from the High Street, with trains to the city about every half hour taking around 35 minutes.

knowledge.q: What are the primary schools like?
knowledge.a: There are two primary schools in town, Brackenford Church of England Primary and Mill Lane Primary. Ofsted reports are on GOV.UK, and places are allocated by the county council.

knowledge.q: Which secondary school is it for?
knowledge.a: Most children go to Brackenford Academy, but catchment areas change, so please check with the county council admissions team.

knowledge.q: Is there a doctor nearby?
knowledge.a: The Brackenford Health Centre on Station Road is the GP surgery for the town and the villages.

knowledge.q: Are there parks nearby?
knowledge.a: Riverside Park runs along the river from Mill Lane, and Coldbrook Common is a short drive away.

knowledge.q: Is there parking in town?
knowledge.a: There are two pay and display car parks off the High Street, and free parking on Sundays.
